scope: One finite independent state-interface acceptance of frozen seed1. No training, recalibration, repair, model switching, new root replacement, WM or planning execution. Local only.
root_balance: 3 target colours x2 declared drawer initial states x2 independent layouts. Root is statistical cluster, not each window or model output.
root_exclusion: New ID and seed; near-duplicate rejection against all archived train/dev/test/controller root layouts across environments and among new roots: all3 named-object distances<=12mm, or all<=20mm and all yaw modulo pi differences<=0.25rad.

candidate_contract.architecture: Frozen DINOv2-small visible patch/ROI features, shared object MLP, object and scene GRUs, held/in/open heads; 675395 trainable reader parameters. Not the full guide ObjectTransformer/RSSM architecture.
public_inputs: visible instance masks and ROI geometry
candidate_contract.decoding: Existing model.py predicate_api and metrics.py known: p>=tau is true, p<=1-tau is false, otherwise UNKNOWN; simultaneous known-true held entities become UNKNOWN. At tau=0.5 ordinary confidence rejection is absent.
unverified_runtime_cases: less than 2.1 seconds of history; no padding rule has been accepted
full closed-loop consumption and completion false-confirmation
uniform 2.1 second sampling for the historical in/open regression states
candidate_contract.normalization: Unchanged original training normalization; copied with SHA-256
candidate_contract.limitations: Seed1 is selected on C development evidence. A successful development challenge is not independent acceptance or probability calibration proof. No runtime deployment is performed.

conditions.baseline: Last frame after exactly 96 open-gripper motor holds from initial reset; no history padding.
conditions.near_open: Last descend_named_block frame with gripper command +1 during lift request, regardless of predicted or actual success.
conditions.near_closed: First descend_named_block frame with gripper command -1 during lift request. Contact/support truth is audited, not assumed.
conditions.held_after_lift: Final frame of requested lift, including failures. Condition achieved only if actual held at anchor.
conditions.held_stationary: Final frame after 96 unchanged closed-gripper hold actions following successful lift. Condition achieved iff all64 consecutive frames held and both TCP/object stay within 1mm of first position. No replacement window.
conditions.held_downward: Open roots only: anchor at first lower_into_drawer phase frame +63, provided the original phase lasts at least64 frames. Condition achieved iff all64 true-held, TCP and object net drop>=20mm, each consecutive z increment<=0.02mm AND total positive z increments<=0.10mm for each. Numerical tolerance disclosed. No window shifting; failed construction remains recorded.
conditions.in_open: Open roots only: final frame of 96 open-gripper holds after successful place; actual target in and drawer open required for intended condition.
conditions.in_closed: Open roots only: final frame of 96 open-gripper holds after successful close; actual target in and drawer closed required.
conditions.natural_one_camera_occlusion: Earliest t>=63 where target is >=4pixels in other camera at t, and for one camera current pixels<4 but max at the four input times>=20. Score regardless of current held truth; no synthetic occluders.
conditions.natural_held_occlusion: Same visibility criterion as natural_one_camera_occlusion, earliest eligible current true-held frame. Private truth selects this preregistered diagnostic stratum only, not inputs.
conditions.natural_both_camera_occlusion: Earliest t>=63 with target<4pixels in both cameras at t and max at any of the four input times>=20; score any physical truth. No synthetic occluders.

control: Unmodified PhysicalOracle.run with existing internal bounded retry; extra holds use unmodified PhysicalOracle.hold(96, existing intended grip). No speed, gains, control limits or poses altered. Initial open drawer is a declared root state, not an intermediate completion teleport. Stop dependent place/close/holds on control failure; retain attempt and missing-condition reasons.

input_processing.startup: No prediction before t>=63; no padding.
input_processing.registry: Fresh VisibleRegistry per complete4-frame window, unchanged RGB colour registration and 2pixel ROI visibility rule. Missing entity stays existing zero feature; no GT identity substitution.
input_processing.model: Same frozen DINO weights, preprocessing, normalization, reader and thresholds. Only objects/context/robot tensors passed.
input_processing.occlusion: No new visibility-based abstention or label masking. Existing held-conflict UNKNOWN decoder only; report registered entity availability separately.
input_processing.ground_truth: Private labels at current t only; ambiguous physical category excluded per existing categorical_valid and counted. Visibility is not a ground-truth validity criterion. Future frames excluded.

denominators.windows: One preregistered anchor per root-condition; report attempted roots, available windows, achieved condition, control/missing-history gaps, GT-invalid facts. Main condition table includes every anchored attempt even if intended physical condition failed; achieved-only table separately labelled.
denominators.facts: All7 held(red/blue/pink), in(red/blue/pink,drawer), open(drawer). Current GT-valid facts scored; unavailable public entity still scored. Raw threshold and actual conflict-decoded known output both retained.
denominators.per_condition_root: Root counts with >=1 FP, FN, UNKNOWN, invalid fact; denominator distinct roots with an available window, plus planned root count. Target truth-positive/negative root denominators separately reported.
denominators.all_facts: Window passes only if all7 truth-valid and known-correct after conflict decoding. Root passes only if every available mandatory window passes and every planned mandatory condition is achieved. Missing/failed construction never counted as pass.
denominators.pooled: Distinct roots cluster multiple windows; never label pooled window count independent. Natural occlusion anchors may duplicate other anchors; retain condition membership and report unique root-anchor count.

decision_rule: Practical capability report, not 1% statistical certification. Recommend unqualified next-interface integration only when required physical coverage exists for each colour and no consequential known false assertions or recurring missed positive states appear. Localized visibility/condition gaps permit at most explicitly scoped research suggestions; list them without retuning. Do not claim general reliability from zero errors in a small sample. WM integration recommendation only; do not start WM.
failure_analysis: First consequential error per root in chronological order, then group existing evidence by cause. No resampling, training, threshold adjustment, repeated acceptance or single-case repair on this set.
old_vs_new_sampling: All acceptance windows use2.1s. Older973 rehearsal training windows and prior historical C used original short histories; acceptance does not retroactively change them.
